processing.dog: 1.48-2.03 s single bark, mono 48 kHz, 90 Hz highpass, 0.65 gain, short edge fades
processing.bird: 0-3.2 s, mono 48 kHz, 500 Hz highpass, 0.65 gain, edge fades
processing.vacuum: 30-42 s steady excerpt, mono 48 kHz, 70 Hz highpass, 0.2 s loop crossfade

limitations: Dog uses Quaternius German Shepard native Idle and Walk; the head movement during bark events is authored and not articulatory synchronization.
The perched bird and robot are locally authored. These are illustrative assets, not scans or exact physical instances.
Recordings are not anechoic; source gains and robot speed are not acoustically calibrated.
Robot geometry and its cleaning route are authored, not a navigation policy or simulated suction.
Earlier Mesh2Motion candidates may remain in the working folder for reference but are not loaded or included in deployment.
